item.title: Danville Police Department Presents Awards for 2025
item.description: The Danville Police Department held the annual awards ceremony on Wednesday. The Partnership Award was presented to the Guilford County North Carolina Narcotics Task Force. It was also presented to Virginia State Police Special Agent Christopher Sizemore.
